title: G-MARK: Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Cooperative Driving via Knowledge Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2608.19964v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous driving systems must operate under partial observability, where safety-critical objects may be occluded or visible only to neighboring connected vehicles. Vehicle-to-vehicle cooperation can reduce this uncertainty, but existing cooperative driving methods often compress multi-agent evidence into latent features or hidden multimodal states. As a result, they obscure which agent observed each object, whether the object is visible to the ego vehicle, and how conflicting evidence affects downstream decisions. We propose G-MARK, a grounded multi-agent reasoning framework that converts cooperative object-centric observations into explicit provenance-aware knowledge graphs (KGs). The resulting KGs preserve object hypotheses together with their source attribution, ego-versus-partner visibility, uncertainty, conflicts, spatial relations, and planning-relevant context. G-MARK then derives a shared feature representation from these KGs,

translated_title: G-MARK：基于知识图谱的地面多智能体协同驾驶推理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19964v1 公告类型：新 摘要：自动驾驶系统必须在部分可观测性下运行，其中安全关键的物体可能被遮挡或仅对邻近的联网车辆可见。车对车合作可以减少这种不确定性，但现有的协同驾驶方法通常将多智能体证据压缩为潜在特征或隐藏的多模态状态。因此，它们模糊了哪个智能体观察到每个物体、物体是否对自车可见，以及冲突证据如何影响下游决策。我们提出G-MARK，一个地面多智能体推理框架，将协同的物体中心观测转换为显式的、具有来源意识的知识图谱（KGs）。生成的KGs保留了物体假设及其来源归属、自车与合作伙伴可见性、不确定性、冲突、空间关系和规划相关上下文。G-MARK随后从这些KGs中推导出共享的特征表示。
tldr: G-MARK通过将多智能体观测转换为显式知识图谱，保留了物体来源和可见性信息，从而提升协同驾驶中的推理透明度和决策可靠性。
en_tdlr: G-MARK enhances cooperative driving by converting multi-agent observations into explicit knowledge graphs that preserve object provenance and visibility, improving reasoning transparency and decision reliability.
